title: StitchVector 3.0 near-miss geometry attribution: rules, pushed and remote-verified before the run on the target data
nature: read-only diagnosis of the frozen M2 (sv_pa, 1fee542) on ALREADY-VIEWED data; no method change, no tuning, not a blind test

data.u2: u2 centre 300x300, Oracle traces + PN1/PN2 (Oracle does not trace text or symbols)

reproduction: per-sample sv_tri (1823cb9) miss classes are recomputed with the same code path (sv_tri.methods / stage_masks / owner / attribute logic) and compared with protabl_triage/tri_result.json; any mismatch is reported

near_miss_split.scope: visible truth samples missed by M2 (owner-credited, 2 px) whose sv_tri class is found_off_or_not_credited (an M2 line within 4 px)
near_miss_split.output_samples: M2 line geometry sampled every 0.5 px with tangents; each output sample is attributed to its nearest truth ink axis

classes_first_match.D_crossing_or_overlap: another truth ink axis lies within 3 px of the sample: ownership is ambiguous at a crossing / overlap
classes_first_match.A_scoring_attribution: an output sample attributed to THIS truth line, tangent within 30 deg, lies within 2 px: geometry meets the 2 px rule, the miss is a scoring / ownership artefact
classes_first_match.B_offset_2_3px: nearest same-line, aligned output sample at 2-3 px: real offset, needs a vertex move
classes_first_match.C_other_ink_line: the nearest output sample within 4 px belongs to another truth ink line (attributed to it within 3 px)
classes_first_match.C_band: the nearest output sample lies in a band zone (band + 2 px)
classes_first_match.C_fill_edge: the nearest output sample lies within 2.5 px of a fill boundary
classes_first_match.C_other_object: the nearest output sample is attributed to another line but is > 3 px from it, not band, not fill edge
classes_first_match.E_uncertain: anything else (e.g. output attributed to this line but not aligned)

metrics.recall_same_line_aligned_2/3/4px: share of visible samples with a same-line, aligned output sample within 2 / 3 / 4 px; 3 and 4 px are sensitivity only

skeleton_split.scope: visible samples missed by M2 whose sv_tri class is skeleton_join_minlen

classes_first_match.lab_only_signal: no grey candidate near the sample: only the unprotected Lab candidate exists (M2 never uses it)
classes_first_match.isolated_candidate_pixels: grey candidate present but its largest 8-connected component near the sample has < 10 px
classes_first_match.no_skeleton_nearby: candidate component >= 10 px but no skeleton pixel within 2 px
classes_first_match.spur_removed: skeleton within 2 px but no chain kept after spur removal within 2 px
classes_first_match.min_len_removed: a kept chain exists and a dropped short group (< 10 px after joining) lies within 2 px
classes_first_match.smoothing_or_simplify_shift: a kept chain exists, not in a dropped short group: lost or shifted by smoothing / simplify / join

skeleton_split.also: runs of consecutive samples per class (a continuous recoverable stretch vs scattered points)

u2: same splits on Oracle traces (G1, G2, G3, red_curve LOOP, red_tooth, red_fault_or_line); count of near misses within 4 px of PN1/PN2
evidence: local zoom sheets with near-miss samples coloured by class (pre-push hook: images not pushed)
redraw_estimate: redraw length = misses not in A (scoring), not in B (move vertices), i.e. C + D + E + all non-near misses; reported per type as an upper bound of what a user must draw
stop_rule: one run; no rule change after the first number; no new detector; no change to M0 / M2 / B2c
